name: HTML app
description: Small apps in notes: an ```html-app block's HTML runs in a sandboxed frame, with three.js and uPlot to import by name. It can't reach the network, your notes or the app, and Stop stops it.

embeds.title: HTML app
embeds.description: An HTML page that runs in a sandboxed frame in the note: a canvas, a three.js scene, a chart, a little tool. Its module scripts may import "three", "three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js" and "uplot" (whose stylesheet is already there). It can't fetch anything or reach your notes.
embeds.body: The page's HTML: elements, <style>, and <script type="module"> that imports what it needs
